description: This file declares functions, types, and macros for utility operations in the LibXDiff (xutils) library, which is used for performing diff operations on files.

methods.name: xdl_bogosqrt
methods.description: Calculates an approximate square root of a long integer.

methods.name: xdl_emit_diffrec
methods.description: Emits a diff record, calling a callback with the record data.

methods.name: xdl_cha_init
methods.description: Initializes a chastore_t structure for storing data.

methods.name: xdl_cha_free
methods.description: Frees or cleans up resources associated with a chastore_t.

methods.name: xdl_guess_lines
methods.description: Guesses the number of lines in a memory-mapped file.

methods.name: xdl_blankline
methods.description: Checks if a line is blank.

methods.name: xdl_recmatch
methods.description: Compares two lines with a certain set of flags.

methods.name: xdl_hash_record_verbatim
methods.description: Computes a hash of a record verbatim, without whitespace normalization.

methods.name: xdl_hash_record_with_whitespace
methods.description: Computes a hash of a record considering whitespace as specified by flags.

methods.name: xdl_hashbits
methods.description: Computes the number of hash bits based on size.

methods.name: xdl_num_out
methods.description: Converts a number to its string representation.

methods.name: xdl_emit_hunk_hdr
methods.description: Emits a header for a diff hunk.

methods.name: xdl_alloc_grow_helper
methods.description: Helper function for dynamic memory allocation with growth.

methods.name: uint64_t xdl_hash_record(uint8_t const ** data,uint8_t const * top,uint64_t flags)

ctags.name: xdl_hash_record
ctags.pattern: /^static inline uint64_t xdl_hash_record(uint8_t const **data, uint8_t const *top, uint64_t flags)$/
